text_block_list.text:
On the day of the Yasuda Kinen, which 
crowns the spring Mile King, the race 
unfortunately met with heavy downpours.

With the track condition this poor, 
anxiety spread among the spectators, 
wondering if even the great Taiki Shuttle 
would struggle to win.

Meanwhile, Taiki Shuttle held a fiery 
passion in her heart that not even the 
rain could dampen.

Determined to excite the crowd with the 
most powerful run imaginable, rain or 
shine, she headed out to face the race in 
terrible weather!
